what: Figma makes the design tool that product teams work in: interface design, prototyping and the shared files where designers, engineers and managers comment on the same screen at once, all in a browser.
customers: Product designers, engineers and product managers at companies of every size, on per-seat subscriptions.
moat: Design files live in Figma and the whole team comments on them, so leaving means moving every file and every engineer's reference point at once. It has become the default in its category.
risks: A $563M net loss, mostly stock compensation after the 2025 listing
6.2 times sales, and the share price has fallen well below the listing level
Adobe and Canva both compete directly, and AI tools that generate interfaces could change the category
opportunities: $224M of free cash flow despite the accounting loss, and $1.7B of cash against $59M of debt
Revenue grew from $505M to $1.1B in two years
Analysts see about 69% upside, with 11 covering the stock, and new products sell to the same accounts
watch: Net dollar retention and the number of customers paying over $100,000 a year.
